subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After direct upstream and sibling Codex inspection, should all 14 action updates land as one batch, or should credentialed token, publishing, security-upload, and Codex actions be split for narrower validation?
rationale: These executable dependencies cross credential and repository-mutation boundaries, while the required dependency and Codex contract inspection could not be completed in this environment.

options.title: Verify and keep batch
options.body: Audit every updated SHA and merge the batch only after dependency guard and exact-head workflow checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL upload, and Codex action updates for boundary-specific validation.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Leave the PR open until direct source inspection and the dependency-check failure are resolved.

recommendation.title: Verify and keep batch
recommendation.body: Audit every updated SHA and merge the batch only after dependency guard and exact-head workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided timeline supplies the only available human routing signal for this security-labeled workflow PR because git-history inspection was blocked.
